intro_questions: Why is cabin pressurization necessary at high altitudes?
What is the primary function of the air conditioning system?
Name two types of air conditioning systems used in aircraft.

summary_questions: Explain the role of the air cycle machine in the typical system.
Describe how cabin pressure is maintained during flight.
